info.name: SmartBoardAI — Auth, administrator accounts and enrollment v1
info.description: Run in order ONLY against npm run postman:serve. Supply its loopback baseUrl and testRunId. Uses a uniquely named disposable MongoDB test database. Credentials use runtime pm.variables only, never saved collection/environment variables. Contains no DB URI or real user credentials. Browser cookies are manually supplied on loopback for wire checks; actual browser HTTPS behavior remains a separate test.

exec: if (!/^http:\/\/127\.0\.0\.1:[0-9]+$/.test(base) || !/^[a-f0-9]{32}$/.test(run)) throw new Error('Use baseUrl and testRunId printed by npm run postman:serve.');
if (!pm.request.url.toString().includes('/health/') && pm.variables.get('confirmedTestRun') !== run) throw new Error('Run health requests first to confirm the disposable host.');
pm.execution.setNextRequest(null); throw new Error('Refusing auth requests against an unconfirmed host.');
pm.execution.setNextRequest(null); throw new Error('Refusing auth requests against an unconfirmed host.');

item.name: 20 Browser refresh with wrong CSRF rejected
24 Reject browser disguising itself as native

exec: const result = pm.response.json(); pm.variables.set('adminAccessToken', result.accessToken); pm.variables.set('fixtureAdminId', result.user.id);

item.name: 34 Reactivation does not restore old credentials

exec: pm.test('Safe CONFLICT error', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().errors[0]).to.deep.eql({message: 'Change conflicts with platform policy.', extensions: {code: 'CONFLICT'}}));

item.name: 61 Reject entire selection with missing device

exec: pm.test('Complete single-page selection', () => pm.expect(page).to.include({page: 1, pageSize: 2, total: 2}));
pm.test('All selected devices revoked', () => pm.expect(page.items.every(d => d.status === 'REVOKED')).to.eql(true));

item.name: 74 Reject private and privilege reset fields
76 Consume recovery proof without automatic login

exec: pm.test('Role and status preserved', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().user).to.include({id: pm.variables.get('recoveryUserId'), role: 'USER', status: 'ACTIVE'}));

item.name: 82 Recovered current account has no credential fields

exec: pm.test('Current account only', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.currentAccount).to.deep.eql({id: pm.variables.get('recoveryUserId'), email: pm.variables.get('recoveryEmail'), role: 'USER', status: 'ACTIVE'}));
